title: The first parade
summary: A red cart, a purple mustache, and a festival full of people to make smile. Take the earliest chapter for a spin.
changes: Drive Zerble through the original festival.
Blow bubbles, honk, and collect smiles.
Meet the early crowds and stage performers.
evidence: Initial scene and early refinements; mainline through 7eb3437. The original changelog retrospectively groups these under May 23.

title: A festival to get lost in
summary: The grounds grow into a place of lakes, woods, shops, campsites, and wandering parades.
changes: Explore camps, vendor interiors, and the camp village.
Find Lurleen and follow the wandering brass band.
Try the growing set of touch and camera controls.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md May 25–28 and f0c763a camp-village integration.

title: Keep the bubbles flowing
summary: Bubble juice gives the journey a new rhythm, while passengers climb aboard and the festival finds its musical voice.
changes: Collect juice jugs and refill at bubble vendors.
Carry seated riders and zoom into the cart.
Hear richer arrangements and applause between songs.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md June 1–4; 5a73bb3 includes the nearby-juice follow-up.

title: The festival stretches out
summary: A more deliberate festival layout connects the places along your route, with more to discover after dark.
changes: Explore the evolving road and festival layout.
Watch nighttime fireworks over the grounds.
Adjust the expanded game settings.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md June 6–22; f7e7bc9 closes the June settings fixes.

title: One more Festival Run
summary: Choose a relaxed cruise or chase a score as the festival's days become more demanding.
changes: Choose Just Cruisin’ or Festival Run.
Build smile chains and manage the rising stakes.
See the festival stretching into the distance behind an arcade-style title screen.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md August 27–31; d680786 is the final August mainline commit.

title: A painted welcome
summary: Painted title art welcomes you back, and the bubble stream has a whole new collection of colors and personalities.
changes: Start from the layered painted festival title.
Discover and unlock special bubble varieties.
Meet more varied crowds, vendors, and performers.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md October 14–16; 8a15434 includes the touch-steering follow-up.

title: Over the hills
summary: The festival rolls across gentle terrain, and a Passport begins collecting the little moments along the way.
changes: Drive over rolling ground.
Fill a Festival Passport during your visit.
Explore woodland camps and markets with browsing shoppers.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md October 22–25; 9eaf2e5 completes the market-shopping integration.

title: Find your own way
summary: A festival map helps you navigate a livelier world, with more expressive people and new details around the camps.
changes: Reveal the festival map as you travel and follow destination pins.
Watch hoop dancers and join temporary activities.
Spot the updated carts, coolers, and character poses.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md October 27–30; 5ef3df2 includes the photographer pose fix.

title: The mountain road
summary: A bigger landscape brings hills, streams, bridges, and a cart that feels the ground beneath its wheels.
changes: Travel between mountain camping districts.
Cross streams on wooden bridges.
Feel physical driving, water encounters, and cart damage.

title: A smoother journey
summary: A run of driving and performance refinements makes the expanded festival more forgiving to explore.
changes: Keep rolling after smaller bumps with gentler cart damage.
Explore with faster terrain sampling.
Travel while distant scenery is prepared in smaller pieces.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md November 5–11; c8ce9a1 completes bounded far-horizon publication.

title: Lantern Night
summary: Glowing lanterns welcome you into a refreshed festival, where passengers have places to go and things to do.
changes: Explore the Lantern Night title, menus, and Passport.
Take passengers to their activities and destinations.
Find cornhole games and hammocks beside the camps.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md November 14–15; 9322888 is the end of the integrated November 15 burst.

title: The festival comes alive
summary: Bands play their parts, stage lights follow the music, and the surrounding woods settle into the evening glow.
changes: Watch performing bands, roaming singers, and crowd applause.
See wooded ridgelines and more faithful distant trees.
Find moving camper shadows inside lantern-lit tents.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md November 16; 380cf22 includes the deployment atlas-verification correction.
